title: Remove the IMS flange and positively identify the bearing variant

notices.text: Identify in this order of reliability: (1) pull the flange and look — a single row of balls in a narrow race with a comparatively wide flange; (2) measure flange dish depth, 19.27 mm for single-row versus 13.34 mm for dual-row; (3) cross-check the engine number stamped on the lower edge of the crankcase. Do NOT rely on model year alone — a warranty-replacement engine could be a different variant. Record the answer on the build sheet before you order any IMS part.

steps.text: Remove the IMS flange and positively identify the bearing variant.

fasteners.name: IMS flange bolts

stages.label: OEM flange: M6 micro-encapsulated 10 Nm (7.5 ft-lb); lock nut on the intermediate shaft flange M8 x 1: 13 Nm (10 ft-lb), or 11 Nm if special tool 9110 is used.

fasteners.note: With an LN kit, the LN instructions replace these values.
